summary.text: Tamara Lesnar is the Libertarian nominee. A former compliance officer at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange who now runs a small collectibles business, she ran for U.S. Senate as a Libertarian in 2022 and for the South Dakota House in 2024. She supports continuing to use vote-tabulation machines and proposes online databases letting residents indicate preferences on issues before lawmakers vote.

paragraphs.text: Former compliance officer at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange; runs a small collectibles business in Grenville.
